sources.evidence: Home page of the organisers' 2021 ECNA contest site titled 'The 2021 ICPC East Central North America Regional Programming Contest', with a preliminary report dated February 27, 2022, plus the problem set page and problem set PDF.
Kattis standings table with 98 team rows, Slv. and Time columns and cells for problems A to M with attempts and minutes; contest over.
Table of 98 teams with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Medal, Citation and Site citation columns.
Page headed 'Problem Set, Solutions and Test Data' with a table of problems A to M, each with a ZIP link, and a link to ecna2021.pdf.
Kattis problem-source page 'Problems from 2021 ICPC East-Central NA Regional Contest' with a table of 13 problems.
Baekjoon category page '2021 East Central Regional Contest ecna2021' with 13 problems numbered 24555 to 24567.
Codeforces gym 104196 dashboard titled '2021-2022 ICPC East Central North America Regional Contest (ECNA 2021)' listing problems A to M.
QOJ contest 864 dashboard '2021-2022 ICPC North America - East Central NA Regional Contest' with problems A to M.
29-page PDF 'The 2021 ICPC East Central NA Regional Contest, Official Problem Set' with a contents list of problems A to M.
